subject: Night surge shuttle routing and personnel pivot for BayView demo
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claudia Ramos <claudia@lumaevents.com>, Trevor Li <trevor@swiftshuttle.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night surge shuttle routing and personnel pivot for BayView demo

Hi Claudia / Trevor,

Quick heads-up: we expect a late-night surge on the first night of the BayView demo (attendee afterparty + VIP teardown) and need a short-notice shuttle + hotel handoff plan for our field crew. Two constraints: 1) several flights arrive after midnight; 2) we need to reassign two engineers from the morning shift to cover evening setup.

Can your ops team provide a 2-hour night window (midnight-2am) with a dedicated 12-person shuttle and a separate 6-person van for VIP gear? Also need a dock-side drop at Loading Dock C instead of B (venue change).

Attached: high-level crew itinerary + current roster (we'll update with names shortly). Please confirm capacity, estimated wait times, and whether drivers can wait 30 minutes past event close if pushback happens.

If helpful, Marissa will send flight/ETA details in the next email.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Field Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: crew_itinerary.xlsx (spreadsheet), shuttle_manifest.csv (placeholder)

From: Claudia Ramos <claudia@lumaevents.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Trevor Li <trevor@swiftshuttle.co>, Luma Events Ops <ops@lumaevents.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night surge shuttle routing and personnel pivot for BayView demo

Hi Jonas —

We can support a midnight-2am dedicated shuttle (12 pax) and a separate 6-person cargo van for gear. Driver staging is available at Loading Dock C, and drivers can standby up to 45 minutes past scheduled pickup for a marginal fee; we'll waive the fee for Redwood on this one.

I've attached the updated hotel block and the preliminary routing PDF. A couple of asks from our side: please provide the final crew list (names + cell) for pre-clear by EOD Wed so drivers can run CPF checks and venue security badges. Also confirm whether any crew need wheelchair-accessible transport.

Quick notes:
- Shuttle ETA to Loading Dock C from SFO (approx): 35–50 mins depending on traffic windows.
- Overnight parking: limited; prefer drivers to drop and shuttle back to hotel.

Thanks — we'll hold both vehicles on provisional hold until we get the roster.

Cheers,
Claudia Ramos
Senior Operations Manager
Luma Events

Attachments: hotel_block_v2.pdf (hotel block with cut-off), routing_night_window.pdf (routing summary)

Subject: Re: Night surge shuttle routing and personnel pivot for BayView demo

Thanks Claudia — attaching the updated shuttle manifest and a couple of roster notes.

Roster highlights (for EOD pre-clear):
- Lead tech: Mina Haddad — arrives SFO 11:38 PM, UA 221
- Tech 2: David Kim — arrives SJC 00:12 AM, AS 413
- Morning shift cover (moving to evening): Rafael Mendes (flight ETA 10:40 PM)
- Float: Priya Natarajan (on standby)

Two requests from our ops side:
1) Can we split the 12-person shuttle into a 6/6 rotation with a 20-min stagger on return to hotel to ease lobby congestion?
2) Please mark the two engineers moving to evening as "priority drop" — they have delicate hardware to unload.

I've attached shuttle_manifest.csv with cell numbers and initial rooming. We'll finalize names tonight after travel team confirms a late swap.

Also flagging that one crew member requires a ground-level pickup (wheelchair access) — Mina; we've noted it in the manifest.

Thanks everyone — Claudia, if you can confirm the 6/6 rotation and priority drop callouts, we'll lock the manifest.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Coordinator, Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: shuttle_manifest.csv (driver-ready manifest)

- Cargo van reserved for VIP gear + priority unload at Loading Dock C.

- Mina listed as ground-level pickup (access noted).

Marissa: we'll proceed with roster in the attached manifest. David, Mina — please reply-all with a quick "On my way" when you hit baggage claim so Claudia's drivers can flag you.
